desc: Parse K, S, and T from stdin; if abs(len(S)-len(T)) > K print No immediately.
Implement the Ukkonen/Landau–Vishkin wavefront with substitution cost 1 and cutoff K, tracking furthest reachable row per diagonal i-j and checking the target diagonal m-n reaches m.
Add the clamping fix (src = min(furthest, m-1 / n+k bounds)) justified by the diagonal-prefix reachability lemma so undercounts (e.g. S="a", T="aa") are handled.
Handle diagonal indexing (size 2K+1, offset K), bounds/guards for k±1, unreachable (-1) states, and early success detection (including d=0).
Keep per-diagonal arrays O(K) wide and use O(log n) rolling-hash LCP so total work is O(K^2 log n + |S| + |T|), suitable for n up to 500000.
Verify against all 3 samples (Yes/No/Yes) and hand-traced edge cases (identical strings, S="a"/T="aa", length diff = K, repeated chars, substitution-vs-indel cases).
